clips.title: KreekCraft escaped a full police hunt in GTA 6… and kept the rocket launcher
clips.caption: Cops lost the trail and KreekCraft walked away with a rocket launcher 🚀
clips.voice_intro: The cops are closing in on KreekCraft. Just listen to that police radio.
clips.voice_outro: Lose the cops, keep a rocket launcher. Honestly a decent trade, but next time he should fire it before the chase even starts.
